assertions.name: ggm_stokes_datum_anchor_invariant
assertions.source: GGM S⁺₁₁ tower swings only 5.99e-06% across the two 11.5-ppb-separated anchors, and the leading Stokes constant −3 is q-independent — the datum is the RIGHT TYPE (anchor-invariant) for a derivation. Passes the type test; the value test is what fails below.

assertions.name: smooth_c3_is_anchor_flat
assertions.source: The smooth Habiro closed form c_3 swings only 6.18 ppb across the anchors — NOT the ~2–3.5% swing of the EXTRACTED c_3 (dc_3/dq≈4.6e6, PR #1821). The extracted swing is 1/u³ ladder-inversion hyper-sensitivity, not physical anchor-dependence. So a Stokes datum being anchor-invariant is CORRECT — the swing is not the obstruction.

assertions.name: stokes_integer_value_refuted_as_c3
assertions.source: H1 (c_3 = raw GGM order-3 Stokes integer −3) gives a Q_β c_3-rung residual of 575.6 ppb — 74× the 7.8 ppb 100× target, and WORSE than even the crude −2 near-match (42.9 ppb). The anchor-invariant Stokes integer (−3) simply is not c_3 (≈−2.069): off ~45%. scope-(a) NEGATIVE — value mismatch, not a fit failure.

assertions.name: substrate_stokes_jump_suppressed
assertions.source: Per 2026-07-18-dladder-fibre-branch-stokes-ambiguity: on the substrate meridian (real q₀) the least term sits at the ladder edge and the Stokes jump exp(−A/u) is ~10⁻²⁷–10⁻³⁹ (anchor-blind) — orders below the ppm-level c_3 rung. The unsuppressed A_ω lives on the fibre branch (|q|=1, u~O(1)), leaving the edge at |u|≳0.19. So no substrate-meridian Stokes ambiguity can source c_3; the open route is the normalized §4e quantum-modularity / 3d-index bridge, not a bare integer.

description: c_3 via the colored-Jones / GGM-resurgence (Stokes) route: a falsifiable two-anchor test. The anchor-invariant GGM order-3 Stokes datum for 4₁ (integer constant 3 on the ι=Vol(4₁)/π singularity; S⁺₁₁ tower eq 61, certified in qbeta-g3-ggm-stokes-41) is the RIGHT TYPE for a derivation (anchor-invariant), but its value (−3) does NOT equal the cal-anchored c_3≈−2.069: plugged into the Q_β ladder it gives a 576 ppb residual (74× the 7.8 ppb 100× target), worse than even the crude −2 near-match (43 ppb). Substrate-meridian Stokes jump is 10⁻²⁷-suppressed (dladder-fibre-branch audit). VERDICT: NEGATIVE, scope-(a) — c_3 is NOT the raw GGM order-3 Stokes constant; the open bridge is the §4e quantum-modularity normalization / 3d-index assembly, not a bare integer. No fit; nothing inverted from Q_β; no c_k wired.

data.verdict: NEGATIVE scope-(a): the GGM colored-Jones/Stokes route supplies a correctly anchor-invariant order-3 datum (integer Stokes constant −3, 4₁ singularity at Vol(4₁)/π), the right TYPE for a derivation — but its value is not c_3. c_3 = −3 gives a 576 ppb Q_β residual (74× the 7.8 ppb target), worse than the −2 near-match (43 ppb); off ~45% from the cal c_3 ≈ −2.069. The substrate-meridian Stokes jump is 10⁻²⁷-suppressed. c_3 is NOT a bare GGM order-3 Stokes constant. The open bridge is the §4e quantum-modularity normalization / 3d-index assembly (a fixed-basis normalization of the anchor-invariant datum), not a raw integer. No fit; nothing inverted from Q_β; no c_k wired; no tier change. Honest NEGATIVE.
